issue.title: Retry orphaned epic prompt archive when epic launch notices plan missing
issue.description: epic_prompt_link_race plan (sase/repos/plans/202607/epic_prompt_link_race.md) fixed the missing-link race for approved epics by making archive_plan_file's PROMPT link deterministic when a prompt snapshot is guaranteed (expect_prompt_snapshot). It did NOT fix the mirror-image orphan-prompt failure mode (see plan section 3.5/8): if the host's plan archive attempt itself fails (e.g. SddIntegrationStatus.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE from a concurrent commit while the epic agent is writing its prompt snapshot), the epic launch proceeds anyway (bead + phase workers get created and start running) but the plan file never lands in the plans sidecar tree, permanently orphaning the prompt snapshot with no plan counterpart. This was just observed live: bead sase-bv ('Attribute beads to the agent that created them') is an in-progress epic (5 phase workers running) whose PLAN field already points to plans:202607/bead_created_by_attribution.md, but that file was never archived into the sidecar -- sase plan links validate reports it as a link-missing-target error. A durable fix would retry the archive (or at least surface a durable, actionable failure) when the epic launch notices its plan is missing from the archive, instead of silently leaving it orphaned forever.
